preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N > 0 and N <= 2*10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and 'N' not in line])
preconditions.description: Each test case's N is a positive integer representing the string length, bounded by 1 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for N, S in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string S has length exactly equal to its corresponding N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string S consists only of lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == N for N, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each output line has the same length as its corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output_line) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line consists only of lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(all(abs(ord(output_line[i]) - ord(output_line[j])) <= 1 or abs(ord(output_line[i]) - ord(output_line[j])) == 25 for i in range(len(output_line)) for j in range(i+1, len(output_line)) if output_line[i] != output_line[j]) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output string can be obtained by swapping adjacent characters (where adjacent means their ASCII values differ by at most 1).

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == min([s for s in permutations(S) if all(abs(ord(s[i]) - ord(s[i+1])) <= 1 for i in range(len(s)-1))]) for S, output_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output string is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by any number of adjacent swaps (where adjacent means their ASCII values differ by at most 1).
